sents.d: Diversifying channels reduces dependence on any single platform.

Relying on a single sales channel — one marketplace or one ad platform — creates risk, since a policy change, account suspension, or algorithm shift on that one channel can significantly impact revenue overnight.

Reasonable next channels to consider once a core store is stable include relevant marketplaces, wholesale partnerships with retailers in your niche, local pop-up events, or, for some products, international shipping to new markets.

Expanding gradually and tracking channel-specific profitability (not just revenue) matters, since new channels often carry additional fees, shipping complexity, or customer service overhead that can quietly erode margins if left unmonitored.

take: Add channels gradually and track profit, not just revenue.
